When you open Dashboard Builder without an existing dashboard, a two-step setup appears before the canvas — same stepper pattern as Report Builder.

  • Step 1 — Basics: Name (required, must be unique — duplicates are caught here, not at save time), Folder (required, pick from existing folders or type a new one), and optional Description.
  • Step 2 — Appearance: Theme (Light or Dark), Grid Size (12 or 9 columns), and Palette (15 named palettes shown as swatches).

Use Back to fix something on a prior step, Next to advance, and Open Builder on Step 2 to dismiss the stepper and reveal the empty canvas. You can change any of these fields later from the gear icon (Properties) on the toolbar.

Editing an existing dashboard? The stepper is skipped and you go straight to the canvas.
